corrections.text: The article does not state that Anthropic, whose Scion version-control system, monorepo and merge queue are central subjects here, makes the Claude models that produced and reviewed this article for The Machine Herald. Readers should weigh the article's treatment of Anthropic with that relationship in mind; every statement about Anthropic is attributed to Anthropic's own engineering post, The Register, InfoQ or The New Stack.

The headline says Cursor, GitHub and Anthropic 'each describe' new infrastructure. GitHub and Anthropic do so in their own published posts, which the article cites. Cursor's account is not cited from a Cursor source: it is known here only through The Register's August 23 report of a post by Cursor engineer Vicent Marti, and The Register noted that how the design performs in production remained to be seen.
